hook.name: NakaHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for the NAKA token on BNB Chain. Buys mint NAKA via a forward curve; sells burn NAKA via an inverse curve. The hook is the sole liquidity source, blocks external LP additions, requires the swapper address in hookData, enforces a per-wallet block cooldown between buys and sells, and auto-forwards fees to a hardcoded donation address. Self-deprecates (disables buys) at 99% of the 21M supply cap.
